entities.name: Butterfly
entities.description: Butterflies are fascinating creatures that undergo a remarkable transformation throughout their life cycle.

attributes.Description: Fascinating creatures that undergo a remarkable transformation throughout their life cycle.

entities.name: egg
entities.description: The egg is the first stage in the life cycle of a butterfly, where the development of the organism begins.;;;The initial stage of a butterfly's life cycle, where it begins as an egg.

entities.name: larva
entities.description: The larva is a stage in the life cycle of a butterfly, following the egg stage and preceding the pupa stage.

entities.name: pupa
entities.description: The pupa is a stage in the life cycle of a butterfly, occurring after the larval stage and before the adult stage. It is a period of transformation and development.

attributes.Description: A transitional stage where the butterfly undergoes metamorphosis.

entities.name: adult butterfly
entities.description: The final stage in the life cycle of a butterfly, following the egg, larva, and pupa stages.

entities.name: life cycle
entities.description: The life cycle of a butterfly refers to the series of stages it goes through from birth to adulthood, which is marked by metamorphosis and transformation.

entities.name: butterfly's life cycle
entities.description: The complete developmental process of a butterfly from egg to adult.

entities.name: larva stage
entities.description: The second stage of a butterfly's life cycle, where it hatches from the egg and begins to feed and grow.

entities.name: pupa stage
entities.description: The third stage of a butterfly's life cycle, where it undergoes metamorphosis inside a chrysalis.

entities.name: adult butterfly stage
entities.description: The final stage of a butterfly's life cycle, where it emerges from the pupa and becomes a fully developed butterfly.
